classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught supplementary-angle procedure to one labelled obtuse triangle.

content.prompt: Find obtuse $\angle ABC$ to the nearest degree.

spec.description: Grey scalene triangle with A upper left, B lower middle and C lower right. Horizontal BC. Black vertex and measurement labels; two-line NOT TO SCALE notice above the right portion.
spec.mathematics: BC=16 cm; AC=25 cm; angle BAC=28°; angle ABC obtuse. Preserve explicitly not-to-scale source shape.
